language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the wooden spoon on the table, closes its gripper around it at frames 76–85, and lifts it at frames 91–110, as shown in image, left_ego_image, and wrist_image. It carries the spoon to the open drawer at frames 111–164 and releases it at frames 165–168. In wrist_image at frames 169–175, the spoon remains inside the drawer while the open gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
